sources.title: GitHub - YAndrewL/Eva: Eva, a multimodal foundation model for spatial ...
sources.snippet: Eva (E ncoding of v isual a tlas) is a foundation model for tissue imaging data that learns complex spatial representations of tissues at the molecular, cellular, and patient levels. Eva uses a novel vision transformer architecture and is pre-trained on masked image reconstruction of spatial proteomics and matched histopathology.
